{{Quote|Here's an old Leffingite favorite, made fresh from juicy, Kessinnamon-spiced Almakian apples baked to perfection in a golden pom seed flour crust.|Dexter Jettster's description of all-Almakian apple pie in his menu|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''All-Almakian apple pie''' was a type of [[Pie/Legends|pie]] that was made from [[Kessinnamon]]-spiced [[Almakian apple/Legends|Almakian apples]] that were baked in a [[pom seed flour]] crust, which had a [[Color/Legends|golden]] color. The pies were [[Diet/Legends|favored]] by the [[Leffingite/Legends|Leffingite]]<ref name="Dex" /> [[Species/Legends|species]], who were native to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Almak/Legends|Almak]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|Almak|I|24}}</ref> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] served all-Almakian [[Apple/Legends|apple]] pies at his [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Jettster used fresh and juicy Almakian apples in his pies and claimed that they were baked to perfection in his menu. The diner charged 2.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for a slice of the pie, with a total cost of 5.7 credits for a serving with a scoop of [[denta bean ice cream]].<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
All-Almakian apple pie was mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article [[Dining at Dex's]], written by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="Dex" />
